name: sum
algorithm: f32 sum of an n-element vector with 16 partial sums in a stated order, reduced as a pairwise tree, then the tail in order; one element changed before each of reps sums; the checksum sums the result's bits (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: a float kernel: no integer arithmetic to wrap

skip.mk: std.simd dispatches at run time (simd.Cpu()), so on an avx2 machine the Mk column runs its 32-lane form; this fixed-v2 variant would compare it with 16-byte vectors. Mk is compared in the v3 variants (status/std-simd.md, request R-3)

std.simd dispatches at run time (simd.Cpu()), so on an avx2 machine the Mk column runs its 32-lane form; this fixed-v2 variant would compare it with 16-byte vectors. Mk is compared in the v3 variants (status/std-simd.md, request R-3)

std.simd dispatches at run time (simd.Cpu()), so on an avx2 machine the Mk column runs its 32-lane form; this fixed-v2 variant would compare it with 16-byte vectors. Mk is compared in the v3 variants (status/std-simd.md, request R-3)

no_counts: B24 does not apply as a count of operations: the work per sum is fixed by n, and the checksum folds every result
notes: GB/s counts the 4 * n bytes of x per sum. The fill (one pass) and its first-touch page faults are timed by each variant's baseline (reps 0) and subtracted (BS-3). The c, rust, zig and go buffers start on a 64-byte boundary (BS-4); the mk column reads an arena slice whose alignment Mk code cannot set without std.raw (BS-4's labelled exception, tests/bench/README.md).

The 16 partial sums and their pairwise tree are std.simd.Sum's stated order (doc/reference.md section 18), as tests/bench/simd/dot states them for Dot, so every column prints the same bits. c: <immintrin.h>, _mm_add_ps at v2, _mm256_add_ps at v3. rust: std::arch, every load from a checked slice (BS-2). zig: @Vector(W, f32). go: scalar with the same 16 sums, labelled (Go has no SIMD layer and no std float sum). mk: std.simd.Sum.

Checksums from the go column (go run testdata/sum.go at each size, 2026-11-07). The repetitions were estimated from the dot row's step rate (sum has twice dot's steps per byte) for about 1 s of the c cell at L1 and L3 (std-simd session 2, 2026-11-07).
Written by the std-simd lane (status/std-simd.md, session 2). Nothing here is published: bench-final publishes (status/bench.md).
